definition.name: Go runtime and complete capsule qualification

steps.name: Capture immutable qualification source inputs
steps.run:
git archive --format=tar.gz --output "$RUNNER_TEMP/go-guest-source.tar.gz" HEAD -- \
  apps sdk/go-guest sdk/rust examples tools crates wit schemas docs .cargo \
  Cargo.toml Cargo.lock rust-toolchain.toml LICENSE NOTICE .github/workflows/go-guest.yml
test "$(stat --format=%s "$RUNNER_TEMP/go-guest-source.tar.gz")" -le 134217728
git rev-parse HEAD > "$RUNNER_TEMP/go-guest-source.sha"

steps.name: Retain the exact reviewed command contract input
Install captured Go compiler namespace
steps.run:
sudo apt-get update
sudo apt-get install --yes bubblewrap
sudo sysctl -w kernel.apparmor_restrict_unprivileged_userns=0

steps.name: Restore compiled Rust dependencies
Install the locked compiler and generator
steps.run:
set -euo pipefail
cargo install --git https://github.com/bytecodealliance/componentize-go --rev 148dba505f8c6c64ad84db777cfde5e34e25098b --locked componentize-go
test "$(wasm-tools --version | cut -d ' ' -f 1,2)" = 'wasm-tools 1.254.0'
mkdir -p "$RUNNER_TEMP/go-guest-tools"
curl --fail --location --max-time 180 --output "$RUNNER_TEMP/go-guest-tools/go.tar.gz" https://dl.google.com/go/go1.27.2.linux-amd64.tar.gz
echo "ecbadb99091a3f46e31f5f934b068b1864eafa7995211b39eaddf76996045fe5  $RUNNER_TEMP/go-guest-tools/go.tar.gz" | sha256sum --check --strict
tar -xzf "$RUNNER_TEMP/go-guest-tools/go.tar.gz" -C "$RUNNER_TEMP/go-guest-tools"
python3 tools/go_guest/runtime.py --prepare-compiler "$RUNNER_TEMP/go-guest-tools/go" --output "$RUNNER_TEMP/go-guest-tools/go-async"
echo "$RUNNER_TEMP/go-guest-tools/go-async/bin" >> "$GITHUB_PATH"

steps.name: Retain pinned reproduction tools
steps.run:
set -euo pipefail
out="$RUNNER_TEMP/go-guest-tools"
cp "$HOME/.cargo/bin/componentize-go" "$(command -v wasm-tools)" "$out/"
sha256sum "$out/componentize-go" "$out/wasm-tools" > "$out/tools.sha256"

steps.name: Generate and compile upstream and constrained LSF components
steps.run: python3 tools/go_guest/probe.py --output "$RUNNER_TEMP/go-guest-probe" --go "$RUNNER_TEMP/go-guest-tools/go-async/bin/go"

steps.name: Qualify proposed transaction shapes and explicit owners with the maintained Go compiler
steps.run: python3 tools/qualify_transaction_contracts.py --language go --output "$RUNNER_TEMP/transaction-contract-go"

steps.name: Compile the authored transaction aggregate and forbidden immediate HTTP variant
steps.run: python3 tools/compile_transaction_guests.py --language go --output "$RUNNER_TEMP/transaction-guests-go"

steps.name: Execute the compiled runtime diagnostic without claiming admission
steps.run:
set -o pipefail
cargo --config .cargo/managed-guest.toml run --locked -p latent-wasmtime --example go_runtime_probe -- "$RUNNER_TEMP/go-guest-probe/lsf-candidate.wasm" 2>&1 | tee "$RUNNER_TEMP/go-guest-probe/runtime-diagnostic.log"

steps.name: Check standalone project source boundaries and closed provenance
steps.run:
python3 -m pip install -r tools/requirements.lock
python3 -m unittest tools.tests.test_go_capsule_authoring tools.tests.test_build_provenance_schemas

steps.name: Qualify standard Go activation ownership and result drain
steps.run:
python3 -m unittest tools.tests.test_go_runtime_overlay
python3 tools/qualify_go_activation.py --output "$RUNNER_TEMP/go-activation"
LSF_GUEST_SDK_LANGUAGE=go LSF_GO_ACTIVATION_FIXTURE="$RUNNER_TEMP/go-activation" cargo --config .cargo/managed-guest.toml test --locked -p latent-wasmtime --test local_service runtime::go::signed_standard_goroutines_sleep_and_drain_use_original_activation_owners -- --ignored --exact --nocapture

steps.name: Qualify compiler checkpoints against unchanged CPU source and native Go
steps.run:
python3 tools/qualify_go_activation.py --output "$RUNNER_TEMP/go-checkpoints" --runtime-profile go-component-activation-v2 --fixture checkpoints
python3 tools/qualify_go_activation.py --output "$RUNNER_TEMP/go-no-checkpoints" --runtime-profile go-component-activation-v1 --fixture checkpoints
LSF_GUEST_SDK_LANGUAGE=go LSF_GO_CHECKPOINT_FIXTURE="$RUNNER_TEMP/go-checkpoints" LSF_GO_NO_CHECKPOINT_FIXTURE="$RUNNER_TEMP/go-no-checkpoints" cargo --config .cargo/managed-guest.toml test --locked -p latent-wasmtime --test local_service runtime::go::signed_compiler_checkpoints_progress_cpu_siblings_and_cancel_original_activation -- --ignored --exact --nocapture

steps.name: Compile context-aware typed HTTP ownership without claiming default transport qualification
steps.run:
python3 -m unittest tools.tests.test_go_http_context
python3 tools/qualify_go_http_context.py --output "$RUNNER_TEMP/go-http-context"

steps.name: Compile ordinary default net/http sources through the finite typed backend
steps.run:
python3 -m unittest tools.tests.test_go_standard_http
python3 tools/qualify_go_http_context.py --output "$RUNNER_TEMP/go-standard-http" --fixture standard-http-conformance

steps.name: Qualify standard timer heap callbacks and physical readiness retirement
steps.run:
python3 tools/qualify_go_activation.py --output "$RUNNER_TEMP/go-standard-timers" --runtime-profile go-component-activation-v3 --fixture timers
LSF_GUEST_SDK_LANGUAGE=go LSF_GO_TIMER_FIXTURE="$RUNNER_TEMP/go-standard-timers" cargo --config .cargo/managed-guest.toml test --locked -p latent-wasmtime --test local_service runtime::go::signed_standard_timers_contexts_and_rearm_keep_original_heap_owners -- --ignored --exact --nocapture

steps.name: Qualify ordinary module initialization under original activation ownership
steps.run:
python3 tools/qualify_go_activation.py --output "$RUNNER_TEMP/go-owned-initializers" --runtime-profile go-component-activation-v4 --fixture initializers
LSF_GUEST_SDK_LANGUAGE=go LSF_GO_INITIALIZER_FIXTURE="$RUNNER_TEMP/go-owned-initializers" cargo --config .cargo/managed-guest.toml test --locked -p latent-wasmtime --test local_service runtime::go::signed_initializer_goroutines_waits_and_timers_start_inside_original_activation -- --ignored --exact --nocapture

steps.name: Test captured Go native graphs and namespace
steps.run: LSF_REQUIRE_COMPILER_ISOLATION=1 python3 -m unittest tools.tests.test_go_application_dependencies tools.tests.test_captured_compiler_isolation

steps.name: Qualify published retry workers and default timers in the captured namespace
steps.run:
python3 tools/qualify_go_runtime_dependencies.py --output "$RUNNER_TEMP/go-published-runtime"
LSF_GUEST_SDK_LANGUAGE=go LSF_GO_PUBLISHED_FIXTURE="$RUNNER_TEMP/go-published-runtime" cargo --config .cargo/managed-guest.toml test --locked -p latent-wasmtime --test local_service runtime::go::signed_published_retry_workers_and_default_timers_keep_original_activation_owners -- --ignored --exact --nocapture

steps.name: Qualify editable projects, all SDK owners, enforced node and printed guide
steps.run: python3 tools/qualify_go_capsules.py --output "$RUNNER_TEMP/go-capsule-authoring"

steps.name: Check captured ordinary HTTP fixture and frozen native product ownership
steps.run: python3 -m unittest tools.tests.test_go_standard_http_gate -v

steps.name: Qualify ordinary net/http contexts and disposal on the signed node
steps.run: python3 tools/qualify_go_standard_http.py --native-qualification "$RUNNER_TEMP/go-capsule-authoring" --output "$RUNNER_TEMP/go-standard-http-signed"

steps.name: Test reviewed module lifecycle and selected frontend
steps.run: python3 -m unittest tools.tests.test_go_dependency_authoring tools.tests.test_guest_authoring_frontend

steps.name: Test controlled native Go declaration and lock authoring
steps.run: python3 -m unittest tools.tests.test_go_native_authoring

steps.name: Test captured library failure and cancellation observation fences
steps.run: python3 -m unittest tools.tests.test_go_dependency_recovery

steps.name: Qualify captured Go libraries in signed components
steps.run: python3 tools/qualify_go_capsules.py --application-dependencies --output "$RUNNER_TEMP/go-capsule-dependencies"

steps.name: Locate failed timer Wasm frames using private read-only source overlays
steps.run:
if test -f "$RUNNER_TEMP/go-standard-timers/GO-ACTIVATION-COMPILE.json"; then
  python3 tools/diagnose_go_timer_failure.py --fixture "$RUNNER_TEMP/go-standard-timers" --output "$RUNNER_TEMP/go-timer-diagnostic"
fi
